recentItems.title: China's Kinastra-1 Upper Stage Expected to Make Maiden Flight Next Year
recentItems.description:
The Kinastra-1 Upper Stage, independently developed by Chinese company CAS Space, is expected to make its maiden flight in Q1 next year, the country’s Science and Technology department reported recently.

As the upper stage, the Kinastra-1 will work like a transport vehicle for satellites. After it's launched into space along with the satellite payload, the rocket drops off, and the Kinastra-1 Upper Stage takes over, transferring satellites between orbits.

And now, after completing months of testing, the upper stage has accumulated over 5,200 seconds of engine ignition tests and is ready for flight tests.

The chief designer of the Kinastra-1 says in the future, it will be used in tandem with the Kinestica-2 rocket for a number of scenarios.

China's 15th Five Year Plan, which started this year, aims to turn the country's space industry into one of its "emerging pillar" industries along with integrated circuits and biomedicine.

recentItems.title: China's Open-Source AI Models Empowering Industries Worldwide
recentItems.description:
Chinese firms making open-source AI models are accelerating upgrades and building a strong following in overseas markets.

The large AI model company MiniMax just released a new multimodal model that can generate a full-length, cinema-style video with synchronized audio, using just a few reference images and text prompts.

Company officials say they've seen many overseas clients adopting their AI product.

In Shanghai, staff from a tech company were conferencing remotely with Malaysia's e-wallet provider, TNG Digital, discussing how a newly developed AI tool could streamline the company's internal data processing.

The size of China's AI industry exceeded 170 billion U.S. dollars last year, up 40 percent year on year.

recentItems.title: Xi, Japarov Chart New Course for China-Kyrgyzstan Ties
recentItems.description:
Following Chinese President Xi Jinping's state visit to Kyrgyzstan, China-Kyrgyzstan cooperation has ushered in a "golden period" of rapid development with the two countries working to translate their longstanding friendship and strong political mutual trust into broader cooperation and greater benefits for their people.

recentItems.description:
